description: This file contains functions and constants for sanitizing HTML content by removing hidden or unwanted elements, including style-based, class-based, and attribute-based hiding mechanisms. It also includes a utility to strip invisible Unicode characters used in prompt injection attacks.

methods.name: hasHiddenClass
methods.description: Checks if a class name string contains any class associated with hidden content.

methods.name: isStyleHidden
methods.description: Determines if a style string indicates the element is hidden based on CSS properties.

methods.name: shouldRemoveElement
methods.description: Decides whether an HTML element should be removed based on tag, attributes, classes, or styles.

methods.name: sanitizeHtml
methods.description: Removes comments and hidden elements from HTML string, returning sanitized HTML.

methods.name: stripInvisibleUnicode
methods.description: Removes invisible Unicode characters from a string to prevent prompt injection.
